flags.exactSource: Note where frost sits longest, where the ground smells damp in dry months, and where khakibos or blackjack grow thick. These plants can grow in disturbed places, but their presence alone does not show whether soil is compacted. Check the soil before deciding what the patch means for your design.
flags.actualCurrentDraft: Ṱhogomelani hune tshando tsha dzula tshifhinga tshilapfusesa, hune mavu a nunukha vhunyisi kha miṅwedzi yo omaho, na hune khakibos kana blackjack zwa mela zwo tsitsikana. Zwimela izwi zwi nga mela fhethu ho vhilinganywaho (disturbed places), fhedzi u vha hone hazwo fhedzi a zwi sumbedzi arali mavu o tsitsikana (compacted). Ṱolani mavu ni sa athu dzhia tsheo ya zwine patch ya amba kha design yaṋu.
